summary.result: It was concluded that the blast furnace slag powder and stone dust can be used in the Eco-permeable polymer concrete.
summary.background: Permeable polymer concrete can be applied to roads, sidewalks, river embankments, drain pipes, conduits, retaining walls, yards, parking lots, plazas, interlocking blocks, etc.
summary.method: The tests were carried out at $20{\pm}1^{circ}C$ and $60{\pm}2\%$ relative humidity.
